engine: v2 crawl + basic checks + 5 function testers

plan.summary: ShopLite is a small e-commerce site selling everyday items (totes, bottles, lamps, notebooks). The demo should showcase the core shopping loop (browse → product → cart), the customer account area (orders, profile), and the admin user-management panel.

demo_journeys.name: Browse & Add to Cart
steps: Landing on the Shop page, see the 6 products with prices and the 'Add to cart' CTA buttons
Click the Canvas Tote product card to open its detail page
On the product page, click 'Add to cart' (the big CTA)
Navigate to /cart to confirm the item appears in the cart

demo_journeys.name: Log In
steps: Navigate to the Log in page (linked from the header / 'Register' toggle)
Enter email and password for Bob Tester
Click 'Log in' and confirm the header changes to 'Hi, Bob Tester'

demo_journeys.name: View & Manage Orders
steps: Open the Orders page from the top nav
See the existing order #1000 (1 item, $45.00) in the table
Demonstrate the 'Delete' action on the order row

demo_journeys.name: Admin – User Management
steps: Open the Admin page from the top nav
View the user table (Bob, Alice, Carol, Dave, Erin) with names, emails, and roles
Highlight that Alice has the 'admin' role while others are 'user'

demo_journeys.name: Edit Account Profile
steps: Open the Account page from the top nav
See the current email (bob@shoplite.test) and display name field
Change the display name and click 'Save' to persist the change

verdict.why: 22 critical failure(s) on the demo path or on high-risk features.

report.summary: The pre-demo check on the e-commerce site returned NOT SAFE TO DEMO, with 22 critical failures, 5 other failures, 6 items needing human review, 5 blocked, 285 untested, and 432 passed across 13 pages. The critical failures cover the homepage (Help link, anonymous resources access, and desktop-versus-phone rendering), the cart Continue shopping link, and the customer journeys for Browse and Add to Cart, Log In, View and Manage Orders, and Edit Account Profile.

demo_journeys.name: Browse & Add to Cart
steps: Landing on the Shop page, see the 6 products with prices and the 'Add to cart' CTA buttons
Click the Canvas Tote product card to open its detail page
On the product page, click 'Add to cart' (the big CTA)
Navigate to /cart to confirm the item appears in the cart

demo_journeys.name: Log In
steps: Navigate to the Log in page (linked from the header / 'Register' toggle)
Enter email and password for Bob Tester
Click 'Log in' and confirm the header changes to 'Hi, Bob Tester'

demo_journeys.name: View & Manage Orders
steps: Open the Orders page from the top nav
See the existing order #1000 (1 item, $45.00) in the table
Demonstrate the 'Delete' action on the order row

demo_journeys.name: Admin – User Management
steps: Open the Admin page from the top nav
View the user table (Bob, Alice, Carol, Dave, Erin) with names, emails, and roles
Highlight that Alice has the 'admin' role while others are 'user'

demo_journeys.name: Edit Account Profile
steps: Open the Account page from the top nav
See the current email (bob@shoplite.test) and display name field
Change the display name and click 'Save' to persist the change
